applyTo: "**/*.md"

# Documentation Instructions

Documentation is an evidence-bearing artifact.

- distinguish current behavior, approved target behavior, historical rationale, and proposal;
- preserve confirmed / documented / inferred / unknown classifications;
- never invent WHY from code structure;
- cite canonical contracts/design docs instead of duplicating policy;
- update material docs when behavior/contracts change;
- include source SHA for generated/reverse-engineered system documentation when freshness matters;
- Mermaid diagrams must match the surrounding prose and evidence;
- do not hide gaps by writing smoother prose;
- business-facing narrative must not introduce facts absent from approved findings.
